prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Works: Predicting the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT are trained to predict the next word in a sentence. This short video explains how that one simple trick produces fluent answers.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't really understand you. It just plays one game: guess the next word. Then it plays it again and again.

props.text: It just guesses the next word.

beats.narration: It learned by reading huge amounts of text, noticing patterns. Given your question, it picks the most likely word, then the next.
Those simple guesses, stacked together, become fluent answers. It sounds smart, but it is pattern prediction, so always check important facts.
